scope: Independent CPU arithmetic from saved predictions; no model/tensor loading, GPU calls, JF100 inspection, game or closed-loop evaluation.

training.coverage_basis: Saved run configuration and one finite, contiguous training log per optimizer step; no independent replay of gradients.

data.name: release-v2
data.scope_note: 512 test + 512 OOD sampled rows, not a full 26,452-row held-out evaluation. Target probabilities, IDs and question metadata bind to the frozen rows.

reload.limitation: Training saved no contemporaneous output-weight digest. Current checkpoint byte hashes establish the snapshot identity only; they do not prove the historical reload used these same bytes.
